newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Defense Stockpile accepts lead tender bids.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Defense Stockpile accepts lead tender bids.

text.p: The U.S. Defense Stockpile said Friday it had accepted bids on 1,040 tonnes of lead worth $731,437 in its tender held Thursday.
The largest award was made to East Penn Manufacturing Co, of Lyon Station, Pennsylvania, which took a total of 700 tonnes at unit prices between 31.71-32.00 cents a pound.
Other awards were made to American Iron & Metal of Montreal, Canada, Speciality Metals & Minerals of Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and Hirsch Metals Corp of Boca Raton, Florida.
The next lead tender will be on Thursday May 1.
